summary: Iteration 14 testing — all 4 new features validated end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (category restriction schema POST+PUT persistence, order blocked when current Zurich hour is within window, wrap-around window blocking, order succeeds outside window, /suivi tracking link in email template, GET /api/orders/{id} 404). Frontend: admin category edit dialog toggle (defaults 20/6) saves and reloads correctly; alarm interval 10000ms literal verified in Admin.jsx and via the wake-lock modal copy ('toutes les 10 s pendant 6 min'); /suivi/{id} shows contact-banner unconditionally, phone tel: link, correct status-label ('En attente de confirmation'), urgent-callout appears only when status=new AND created_at older than 2 min (verified by patching Mongo to 3 min ago), and does NOT appear on fresh orders; /commander page shows cat-restrict-badge-{catId} with 'Indisponible jusqu'à Xh' when current hour is inside the restriction window.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 1881 lines — should be split into per-tab modules (OrdersTab, MenuTab, SettingsTab, etc.) for maintainability.
server.py is 962 lines and mixes routers/models — consider splitting into routers/ and models/ modules.
Category CRUD endpoints do not validate 0<=restricted_start_hour<=23 (Pydantic Optional[int] accepts any int). Backend silently accepts e.g. 25. Recommend adding Field(ge=0, le=23) constraints.

Time-restriction validation is skipped if only one of start/end is set (both required together). Consider raising 422 at persistence time when only one is provided instead of silently ignoring at order time.
OrderTracking polls every 8s while a separate clock updates every 15s — logic works but a single interval could serve both.
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own TEST_ prefixed categories/products/orders and clean up afterwards. One TEST_ order remains (no delete-order endpoint) — safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite for iteration 14 lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter14_restrictions_tracking.py. It creates temp categories/products, so it is safe to re-run. For /suivi urgent-callout testing, the pattern is: POST /api/orders → update the order in Mongo with created_at older than 2 min → open /suivi/{id}. Category restriction: sh<eh blocks [sh,eh); sh>eh wraps midnight (h>=sh OR h<eh).
rca of the issue: N/A — all features working as specified.
